discovery: Bandits have cornered a group of merchants, rifling through their cart.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

sneak_success: You slip past unseen and watch the bandits finish their shakedown from the bushes. Once they leave, you search the cart they left behind.
sneak_fail: A twig snaps underfoot - the bandits spin around, weapons already leveled.
ignore: You leave the merchants to their fate and press on, their cries fading behind you.

aftermath.discovery: The bandits are dealt with. The merchants are already sorting through what's left of their cart.

choices.label: Escort the Cart to Town
choices.description: See the merchants safely back to Northfield
choices.outcome: You walk alongside the cart the rest of the way to Northfield. The merchants make good on a share of the recovered goods once they're safely behind the town gates.

choices.label: Take Your Cut and Go
choices.description: Help yourself to some of the recovered cargo
choices.outcome: You take what you can carry from the wreckage before the merchants can object. They watch you go with sour faces.

choices.label: Leave Them to It
choices.description: ESC also cancels - they can manage from here
choices.outcome: You leave the merchants to pick up the pieces on their own and continue on your way.
